title: Invertibility of the diagonal completed-unit coefficient comparison
statement: For every Coefficients datum a over a prime l, a finite Padic-l coefficient field E and a scheme T with the stated derived localizations, and every normalized inverse-limit datum L, the specified map a.unitMap l E L is invertible. The coefficient datum and the map are precisely those of def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients.

source.place: paragraph (1), Milnor comparison for quotient and root towers

proof.text: Forget the discrete scalar action. The two recorded projection equations identify the coefficient cone with the image of the completed coefficient-ring limit cone, ; reflection of limits makes its ordinary cone lift invertible.

The quotient transitions are constant sheaves of surjective ZMod quotient maps. The constant/sheaf-composition comparison and faithfulness of scalar forgetting transfer epimorphy to the restricted coefficient tower.
Apply the epimorphic ordinary-to-derived comparison, then compose it with the invertible ordinary cone lift and the exact single-functor comparison isomorphisms in unitMap.

proof_origin.place: Passage to the limit; normalized Roos-unit implementation of the coefficient comparison in trace paragraph (1).
